here (mirror of OCO `seed_amend_legs`'s `to_display` closure), then delegate
to `update_trigger_input`. Empty / `-1` pass through unchanged; linear/USDT
and SPOT are identity no-ops (`base_price_to_display` returns the input). A
failed lookup (standalone host, instrument not loaded) falls back to the raw
base — no worse than the pre-seed behaviour. No-op after `release()`.

path already lands display-domain values, so a second conversion would
double-convert.

Mirrors ObjC `OKTPOSWAPHandler.isFundingRateTimeEqualOrGreatThanDeliveryEndTimeWithOfflinePlanModel:fundingRate:`.

When true, Native should:
1. Hide the predicted funding rate
2. Show the current funding rate as 0%
3. Change countdown label from "until settlement" to "until delivery"
4. Use the delivery time for countdown instead of settlement time

# Parameters
- `plan_model`: The offline plan model from Interactor state
- `funding_time`: `fundingRate.fundingTime` (millisecond timestamp string)
- `quick_state`: `fundingRate.quickState` ("1" for quick delist, bypasses time check)

# Returns
`false` if quick_state is "1"; otherwise `true` if `fundingTime >= startTime`

fields.name: tpsl_entry_visible
fields.doc:
Whether the per-row TP/SL entry button is shown.

Native contract (`DexAssetsListItemBinder.handleBtnLayout`, `:181`):
`dexTpSl.isVisible = TradeAbTestManager.showSessionKey() && data.tokenType != STOCK`.

Derived in Rust (see
`positions_asset::domain::dex_transform::derive_dex_tpsl_entry_visible`) so the render
gate and both action gates - `allowed_actions` push of
`PositionListActionId::OpenDexTpsl` and `DexActionLaunchSeed::tpsl_enabled` - read one
single truth and cannot drift apart.

NOTE: `cefi_support` is deliberately NOT part of this gate. Native never consults it
for the TP/SL entry; using it hid the button for every DEX-only token (device report
2026-09-23, regression from OKTrade `81cc2ac7771` / OKCore `53e7657ec1`).

doc:

name: LiqRiskLevel
doc:
Liquidation risk level for cross-mode positions with shared margin.

Mapped from mgn_ratio thresholds (Kotlin: TradeMmrUtil.calcRiskLabelAndLevel2):
- mgn_ratio * 100 > 500 → Low
- mgn_ratio * 100 > 300 → Medium
- mgn_ratio * 100 > 100 → High
- mgn_ratio * 100 <= 100 → Liquidation

doc:

already-settled HIT rows for the current series and writes them into
